items.prompt: This picture fraction shows thirteen fifths. But we can also see that it counts two whole units… Plus, three fifths more. So we can also write that in symbols as a mixed number, like this.

items.prompt: Here there are three units counted, plus one fifth. We write that as a mixed number like this.
